notes: Sister property to Sawela Capella Lodge (same operator, same building/address, same contract T&Cs, but a DIFFERENT room lineup and DIFFERENT rates) - see sawela-capella-lodge-2026.json. Do not conflate the two.

Two rack/contract rate documents exist with the same filename pattern but genuinely different content: one titled 'CONTRACTS RATES (Revised)' is actually the Sawela Capella Lodge contract (misfiled/mislabeled at the top-level of this folder rather than nested under a Capella-specific name) - its content is captured in sawela-capella-lodge-2026.json instead, not here.
Non-Resident Rack rate is a single flat figure covering all 12 months of 2026 - no seasonality - unlike the more detailed seasonal Contract (Sunworld) rate.

Contract (Sunworld) rate is LOWER in low season than the flat Rack rate but HIGHER in high season for some categories - not a simple percentage-off relationship; both are quoted verbatim rather than forcing a discount-ratio interpretation.

boatExcursion.raw: US$50 per boat per hour, minimum 2 pax per boat

easterChristmasSupplement.raw: US$45pp applies 24, 25, 26, 31 Dec & 1 Jan. Minimum stay 3 nights (24-26 Dec).

includes: Access to grounds for team building
conferenceTeamBuilding_2026.deposit: 80% upon confirmation, 20% at least 5 days prior to event
conferenceTeamBuilding_2026.cancellation: 15-7 days: 50% of rate/room-night; <7 days or no-show: 100%

childPolicy.raw: 0-3yrs sharing with parents: free. 4-12yrs sharing with parents: 50% per person sharing. 4-12yrs own room: 75% (max 2 children); 3rd child pays double room rate.

singleRoomPolicy.raw: Max 3 singles only - beyond that, 80% of double room rate or contract rate (whichever higher) charged per additional single.

policies.tourLeaderDiscount: 1 free pax in 16th room for groups of 15+ paying rooms/night
policies.releasePeriod: Low season: 30 days; High season: 45 days
policies.honeymoonOffer: Fruit/flower basket, sparkling wine, double bed - for stays of 4+ nights
policies.cancellation: 45-30 days: 15% of rate/room-night; 29-20 days: 25%; 19-15 days: 50%; <14 days or no-show: 100%
policies.deposit: 25% deposit 45 days before arrival + full payment 7 days before arrival; within 30 days of arrival: 50% deposit + full payment 7 days before arrival
policies.invoiceDispute: Must be raised within 14 days of invoice receipt
